title: Run of the selected coin branch
statement: Let $N_0,N_1$ be finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols, let $x$ be a Boolean input, let $b\in\{0,1\}$, and let $w$ be a choice word. Starting from its initial configuration on $x$, the machine that first selects between $N_0$ and $N_1$ according to $b$ and then simulates the selected machine under $w$ reaches the configuration obtained by embedding that machine's run into the corresponding branch: it is the embedded run of $N_1$ when $b=1$ and the embedded run of $N_0$ when $b=0$.
hypotheses_covered: $N_0,N_1$ are finite nondeterministic Turing machines with Boolean symbols
